title: PAN
section: [ What should I do if I am unable to link my Aadhaar with PAN either online or through SMS facility as mentioned above?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-14) You can link your Aadhaar with PAN using Biometric Aadhaar Authentication services. Click [ here](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/downloads/Aadhaar_Seeding_Request_Form.pdf) to download Aadhaar Seeding Request Form and visit [**designated PAN centre**](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/downloads/List_of_TINFC-PAN_Centre_Biometric_27092019.xls) for Biometric Aadhaar Authentication along with supporting documents i.e. copy of PAN card and Aadhaar card. Unlike abovementioned online services, linking of Aadhaar with PAN using Biometric Aadhaar Authentication is chargeable. [ What is the new DigiLocker facility in the PAN application?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-15) This facility allows you to securely link your DigiLocker account to your online PAN application. By doing so, you can directly fetch your verified digital documents (like your Driving Licence or Birth Certificate) as proof, eliminating the need to manually scan and upload them. [ What are the benefits of using DigiLocker for my PAN application?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-16)   * **Faster Processing:** Because the documents are digitally verified and untampered, your application bypasses manual back-office human verification, moving straight to processing.   * **Paperless & Secure:** You do not need to print, sign, scan, or upload physical documents.   * **Error-Free:** Your details are securely pulled straight from government databases, reducing the risk of data rejection.  [ Which documents are handled by DigiLocker and which by Aadhaar?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-17) When you choose the Aadhaar-based online application mode:   * Your Proof of Identity (POI) and Proof of Address (POA) are automatically verified using your Aadhaar Card.   * Your Proof of Date of Birth (DOB) can be pulled securely from DigiLocker using an approved document of your choice.  [ Which documents can I fetch from DigiLocker for my Date of Birth (DOB) proof?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-18) You can select any of the following valid documents from the dropdown list on the application page to pull from DigiLocker:   * Birth Certificate issued by the Municipal Authority or any authorized office   * Driving Licence   * Matriculation Certificate   * Matriculation Marksheet of a Recognized Board   * Marriage Certificate issued by the Registrar of Marriages   * Domicile Certificate issued by the Government   * Other documents as specified under Rule 158 of Income Tax Rules, 2026  [ What should I do if I only have one of these unsupported documents?](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-general.html#english-19)   * If you choose to use a Passport, Voter ID, CGHS, or Ex-Servicemen Card, you will need to bypass the automated DigiLocker flow and manually upload a scanned copy of the document for verification.
